_comment: Written by scripts/regen-src-golden.mjs (#91). `sha256` must match tests/fixtures/src-bundle.golden.js — tests/src-bundle-parity.test.ts enforces it, so a hand-edited golden, or one regenerated by any means that skips the reason prompt, fails the gate.
reason: #151 Tier A (branch-wide, supersedes the per-commit reasons): four pure internal renames — fuckbuilding->structureHandoffActive, fuckbuildinggiga->structureHandoffGiga, buyshitspire->buySpirePrep, fuckjobbies->jobBoxesHidden. No persisted setting id, DOM id or string-keyed dispatch moves. Proven byte-pure per commit by reverse-renaming the fresh bundle and asserting byte-identity with the prior golden. The ONE non-rename delta in this golden is an export-map reorder: buyArms,buyshitspire,buyWeps becomes buyArms,buySpirePrep,buyWeps, i.e. two adjacent lines swap because buySpirePrep sorts before buyWeps where buyshitspire sorted after. An Object.assign spread with no duplicate keys is indifferent to property order. L0 baseline-zero stays at zero across all 21 traces; note settings-visibility.ts is guiLoop-driven and therefore structurally invisible to that net, so the byte golden is the load-bearing evidence for those call sites.
